description: This file provides helper functions and command plan builders for sandbox file system mutations, including operations like write, read, mkdirp, remove, and rename, with embedded Python script snippets for execution.

methods.name: buildPinnedMutationPlan
methods.description: Constructs a command plan for a sandbox mutation operation with embedded Python script execution.

methods.name: buildPinnedWritePlan
methods.description: Builds a command plan for writing data to a sandbox path.

methods.name: buildPinnedMkdirpPlan
methods.description: Builds a command plan for creating directories recursively in sandbox.

methods.name: buildPinnedRemovePlan
methods.description: Builds a command plan for removing files or directories in sandbox, with options for recursive and force removal.

methods.name: buildPinnedRenamePlan
methods.description: Builds a command plan for renaming/moving sandbox entries.
